GLP-1 secular winner, +3.37% Monday outperformance on broad weakness. BUY signal Apr 30 at $902 with +13.2% run. Mounjaro/Zepbound pipeline deepening with Alzheimer's and sleep apnea indications. Healthcare defensive rotation beneficiary in early risk-off regime. $910B mcap, forward P/E 23.

Energy momentum with WTI at $104.28. BUY signal May 11 at $115 with +8.8% follow-through. Above 50-DMA ($123.25) and well above 200-DMA ($102.77). Pioneer-like E&P pure play benefiting from OPEC+ discipline. Forward P/E 13.9 with 2.7% dividend yield.

Infrastructure cycle leader, +39.4% above 200-DMA. Industrials led sector rotation Monday with defense and aerospace topping the tape. IIJA spending accelerating into 2026-2027. Backlog at record levels. Forward P/E 28.9 reflecting pricing power and services margin expansion.

Pullback from $984.70 52W high to $928.74 (-1.86% Monday). 30Y yield at 5.18% — two-decade high — directly expands NIM and capital markets activity. CICC Research target raise to $825 (already exceeded). IPO pipeline fattest since 2021. Forward P/E 14.2 reasonable for cycle high earnings.

European energy major near 52-week high ($94.17). BUY signal Apr 29 at $92.06 holding firm. Brent $111 supports integrated model. Forward P/E 9.2 with 4.5% dividend yield — cheapest energy major globally. Weak EUR/USD (1.161) tailwind for USD-denominated revenues.

Enterprise cloud transition accelerating. BUY signal May 15 at $168.92 with +5.8% follow-through. +2.39% Monday showing relative strength. Cloud backlog grew 29% YoY in Q1. Forward P/E 18.8, well below historical premium. Above both 50-DMA ($174.58) and 200-DMA ($229.79 — note: ADR adjusted).

APAC diversifier, BUY signal May 5 at $20.12 with +13.1% follow-through. PS5 Pro cycle driving gaming segment, image sensor division benefiting from AI smartphone upgrade cycle. Hang Seng +0.48% and ASX +1.17% show Asia resilience. Forward P/E 19.1, 7.5% dividend yield.

Energy sector ETF near 52W high ($63.46), +1.17% Monday. WTI $104 and Brent $111 sustain the sector bid. Top holdings XOM (+1.63% Mon), CVX, COP all in uptrends. Captures broad energy beta without single-stock risk. OPEC+ discipline and geopolitical premium support $100+ crude.

Semis ETF with BUY signal since Apr 1 at $390, +39.5% run. NVDA earnings May 20 AMC is the binary catalyst — AI capex cycle intact per hyperscaler guidance. MU +2.52% Monday on analyst upgrades. Wide entry range $525-550 accounts for post-earnings volatility. NVDA 30% weight = high-conviction play on AI infrastructure.

stressScenarios.description: Fed rate hike +100bps: equities fall via ERP compression, bonds reprice
Equity market crash -20%: beta-adjusted drawdown across all positions
VIX spike to 40: volatility repricing, equity decline proportional to vol exposure
Crypto crash: BTC -30%, altcoins down more, minimal equity impact
Geopolitical crisis: risk-off flight to safety, equity decline, gold/USD rally
